score_kind: heuristic visual similarity (not a calibrated probability)
verdict: The render is geometrically faithful: circle, diameter AD, chords AB, AC, BC, the BC/AD crossing and all five labels match the original. The only visible difference is that the point dots are somewhat smaller than in the original.

issues.description: Point markers are visibly smaller than in the original. The original dots (especially O and the endpoints A, B, C, D) have a larger filled radius, roughly 6 px against about 4-5 px in the render.
issues.suggestion: Increase the fill radius in the point loop, e.g. change \fill (\p) circle (0.070) to about (0.095), or use a slightly larger value for O only.
